notes.title: Shooty Mine Beta Release!
notes.notes: Update 0.3 is now live with Shooty Mine moving into beta testing. New character models with brand new sounds and animations. Quality of life updates have been done to the creator (formerly: Map Editor) as well as Steam Workshop integration. Upload your custom maps made in the creator right to Steam. Download other user's maps and play them!

notes.title: Second Character and Map Editor!
notes.notes:
Update 0.2 is live! Enjoy playing the new tank character. Spawn a wall to protect yourself, do more damage, have a larger health pool but watch out, your movement is much slower.

The brand new map editor is also part of this update! Enjoy making maps with all new destructible assets and materials. Spawn, duplicate, paint and delete assets as you see fit. Save the map and launch it in the host game to blow it all up and have a competitive match with your friends and random people on the internet!
